_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed.
reason: 2026-08-04 11:24Z full cycle: 7 fresh candidates checked, closer-to-kickoff recheck of two carried over from 08:15Z plus 5 new. BG Pathum United/Aston Villa (12:30Z kickoff, ~1h out): this time found a real 3-way book (Pathum 9.00 / Draw 7.00 / Villa 1.18) -- power-devig gives Pathum ~0.0755 vs PM 'Will Pathum win' Yes 0.065-0.075 -- within ~0.5-1pt, efficiently priced, no edge. Bournemouth/Genoa (13:00Z kickoff): only an aggregator 'prediction model' page mixing a model percentage (47.15% Bournemouth) with unrelated per-outcome book odds (1.55/4.6/5.4 from different books, implying a different 64.5%) -- internally inconsistent mixed-source construction, same red flag as prior UCL findings, skipped per coverage precondition. T1 Academy/KT Rolster Challengers (LCK CL, ~14:00Z): only an 'average odds across bookmakers' figure again (T1 1.583/KT 2.18), no date/tournament attribution, direct book pages (Pinnacle, Thunderpick) 403'd on verification -- unverifiable, same unresolved issue as the 04:16Z cycle, skipped. Pirates/Brewers run line: only source found was explicitly date-labeled Aug 3 (yesterday), not today's game; covers.com and sportsgrid game pages 403'd -- no correctly-dated line retrievable, skipped. Athletics/Reds: moneyline found (A's +118/Reds -142) but PM has no moneyline market for this game, only O/U 8.5/9.5/10.5; sportsbook total is 9 (not 9.5) -- half-point mismatch, no matching instrument, consistent with the established MLB O/U skip rule. 1win/Vici Gaming (Dota2, Essence II): no odds retrievable for this specific matchup at all -- skipped. Eternal Fire/INOX Division (CS2, NODWIN): only source found was Polymarket's own price echoed back -- circular per MO-01, skipped. No qualifying edge found this cycle. 19 full cycles already ran in the last 24h (>= min_full_cycles_per_day=4). Next event boundary: BG Pathum/Aston Villa and Bournemouth/Genoa both kick off within ~1.5h (already researched to conclusion, will be in-play after) and T1/KT Rolster ~14:00Z (still unverifiable, unlikely to change); set to 14:15Z (~3h out, at the pacing cap) so tonight's evening MLB slate has time to get correctly-dated lines posted and more esports candidates enter the window; settle+monitor still run every tick.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick.
